expr: (() => { window.simRestart(); window.simAdvance(5); const a=window.simState.pMeasured; window.simRestart(); window.simAdvance(5); return a > 0.5 && a === window.simState.pMeasured ? 1 : 0 })()
note: determinism: two runs from the load state (seeded PRNG) give exactly the same pMeasured after simAdvance(5)

expr: (() => { window.simRestart(); window.simAdvance(5); const a=window.simState.pMeasured; window.simRestart(); for (let i=0;i<50;i++) window.simAdvance(0.1); return window.simState.pMeasured / a })()
note: fixed physics step: 5 s in one call or in 50 calls of 0,1 s gives the same pMeasured (independent of frame rate)
